foot: The buyers see it in Requests to buy. Nothing is ordered from a supplier yet.

options.failed: Couldn’t read the materials and work orders

field.materialHint: A material of the library we buy (not a finished product).
field.materialMore: Showing the first materials: type to find the one you need.
field.materialPlaceholder: Type a code or a name…
field.needDateHint: The day it must be at the site.
field.descriptionHint: Size, model, brand — words for the buyer.
field.workOrderHint: The open work order it is for, if any.
field.reasonHint: What it is for, so the buyer can decide.
field.noteHint: Read only if an approval rule asks a yes first.

shortage.notEnough: Not enough material for this work order: the stock and what is on order do not cover it.
shortage.delayed: What is on order arrives too late for this work order.

DRAFT.title: Draft the purchase order now
DRAFT.body: Adds a line to the supplier’s open draft (or a new draft). Nothing is sent to the supplier yet.

REQUEST.title: Send to the buyers
REQUEST.body: It waits in Requests to buy; an approval rule may ask a yes first.

sent.title: Request sent
sent.body: It waits for the buyers in Requests to buy.

waiting.title: Sent — it waits for a yes first
waiting.body: An approval rule asks a yes before the buyers see it. Someone other than you decides.

drafted.title: Purchase order drafted
drafted.new: A new draft {number} was made with this line.
drafted.added: The line was added to the draft {number}.

done.inQueue: You can follow it in Requests to buy.

held.noAsk: Asking to buy needs purchasing.requests.ask. Ask an administrator.
held.noDraft: Drafting a purchase order is for buyers (purchasing.manage): send it to the buyers instead.
held.offline: Offline — send it when the connection is back.
held.quantity: Type how much: a number above 0, at most four decimals.
held.needDate: Pick a day from today on.

problem.read: The server did not answer as expected. Try again.
problem.forbidden: Your role cannot see or do this.
problem.offline: No connection to the server. Check the network and try again.
problem.gone: It no longer exists, or belongs to another company.
problem.write: It was not sent. Try again.
problem.changed: Someone changed it meanwhile: read it again and try once more.
problem.invalid: Something was not accepted. Check and try again.
problem.slowDown: Too many tries at once. Wait a moment and try again.

refused.quantity: The quantity was not accepted: a number above 0, at most four decimals.
refused.needDate: The day was not accepted: from today, at most two years ahead.
refused.reason: Say why it is needed (at most 2000 characters).
refused.description: The words are too long (at most 2000 characters).
refused.itemId: This material cannot be bought: it is archived, or a finished product.
refused.itemColourId: This colour is not an active colour of the material.
refused.uom: The material is not counted in this unit.
refused.workOrderId: The work order is not an open work order of this site.
refused.siteId: This site cannot be asked for.
refused.shortageGone: This work order is not short of this material any more: nothing to ask.
refused.shortageAsked: This shortage was asked already: its request waits for the buyers.
refused.approverSelf: Every approval rule that holds names you as the approver: ask an administrator to change the rule.

mine.label: My requests to buy

noAccess.title: Requests to buy are not in your role
noAccess.body: Asking to buy needs purchasing.requests.ask. Ask an administrator.

empty.title: You have asked for nothing yet
empty.body: Ask the buyers for a material: what, how much, by when and why.

mine.takeBackBody: The buyers will not see it any more. A request that waits for a yes is withdrawn with it.
mine.notYours: Only the person who asked (or a buyer) can take it back.
mine.decided: It is decided already: it cannot be taken back.
